disclaimer: This tool is a cognitive risk screening aid designed for preliminary assessment, NOT a clinical diagnosis. Results must be interpreted by qualified healthcare professionals.
disclaimer_or: ଏହି ଉପକରଣଟି କେବଳ ଏକ ପ୍ରାଥମିକ ଜ୍ଞାନଗତ ବିପଦ ଯାଞ୍ଚ ସହାୟକ, କୌଣସି ଡାକ୍ତରୀ ନିଦାନ ନୁହେଁ। [needs native review]

fields.name: Sex
fields.label: Biological Sex
fields.help_text_or: ଜନ୍ମ ସମୟର ଜୈବିକ ଲିଙ୍ଗ। [needs native review]

fields.name: EDUC
fields.label: Education (years)
fields.help_text: Total years of completed formal schooling (0-30).
fields.help_text_or: ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଶିକ୍ଷାର ମୋଟ ବର୍ଷ (୦-୩୦)। [needs native review]

fields.name: SES
fields.label: Socioeconomic Status (1-5)
fields.help_text: Hollingshead socioeconomic status index (1=Highest, 5=Lowest). Optional, automatically imputed if missing.
fields.help_text_or: ସାମାଜିକ-ଅର୍ଥନୈତିକ ସ୍ଥିତି ସୂଚକାଙ୍କ (୧ ରୁ ୫)। ଅନୁପସ୍ଥିତ ଥିଲେ ସ୍ୱୟଂଚାଳିତ ଭାବେ ପୂରଣ ହେବ। [needs native review]

fields.name: MMSE
fields.label: MMSE / HMSE Total Score (0-30)
fields.label_or: ଏମ୍.ଏମ୍.ଏସ୍.ଇ / ଏଚ୍.ଏମ୍.ଏସ୍.ଇ ମୋଟ ସ୍କୋର (୦-୩୦) [needs native review]
fields.help_text: Total score from Mini-Mental State Examination or Hindi/Odia Mental State Examination (0-30). Only required for test-assisted screening.
fields.help_text_or: ଜ୍ଞାନଗତ ପରୀକ୍ଷଣର ମୋଟ ସ୍କୋର (୦-୩୦)। କେବଳ ପରୀକ୍ଷା-ଆଧାରିତ ସ୍କ୍ରିନିଂ ପାଇଁ ଆବଶ୍ୟକ। [needs native review]
